label: Counting all
description: To solve a + b: count out a set of a objects, count out a separate set of b objects, then count all of the objects together from 1 to find the total. The earliest, most concrete addition strategy in the CGI progression.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
